page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head and page number at the top. Below the text, two footnotes in smaller type. A catchword sits at the lower right.

main_text.p: tholicus est, Impressioni praefuisse, dili-genterque cavisse, ne quid atrox in Reli-gionem Catholicam patri elapsum fuis-set ; deinque quia Barberinus Morino objecerat autoritatem Concilii Triden-tini, illiusque de vulgata editione decre-tum, ille respondit, si hac in parte accu-setur Capellus, acculandos quoque doc-tissimos Ecclesiae tractatores, profertque Bellarmini testimonium, de vulgata ita scribentis Lucae Brugensi, Anno 1603. {i}Scias velim, vulgata à nobis non esse accuratissimè castigata: multa enim de industria iis de caulis[?] pertransivimus, quae correctione indigere videbantur ; variae Lectiones, quae in Bibliis Lovaniensibus habentur, & in quas tu Librum utilissimum scripsisti, mihi videbantur omnino addenda. Atque ibidem hæc Cardinalis Baronii verba {k}de isto negotio proferuntur: Fateor, in Bibliis nonnulla adhuc superesse, quae in melius mutari possunt. Hoc argumentum de ratione, qua in tel-
{i} Bellarm. Epist. ed. in fine Biblior. Antuerp. Anno 1608.[?]

page.notes: Page begins with the fragment "tholicus", the start of "Catholicus", with the C cut off by the edge; kept as a fragment. The footnote year reads "Anno 16 8." with a gap, taken as 1608 and marked uncertain. "caulis" in the italic line is printed this way and may be a misprint for "causis"; marked [?]. Long s and the qv spellings were normalised to s and qu, following the rules. The catchword "ligi" is the first word of the next page, kept in bottom_margin. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
